SELECT d.DEVICE_ID, o.ALIAS, TRANSPORT, REGISTER_EXPIRES, REGISTER_TIME, DEVICE_TYPE, d.MANUFACTURER, d.MODEL, FIRMWARE, MAX_CAMERA, IF(d.`status` = 1 AND DATE_ADD(d.register_time,INTERVAL d.register_expires SECOND)>NOW(), 1, 0) AS `STATUS`, GB_VERSION, COUNT(c.channel_id) AS cameraInCount, IF ( d.`status` = 0 OR NOW()>DATE_ADD( d.register_time, INTERVAL d.register_expires SECOND ), COUNT(c.channel_id), SUM( c.`status` = 'OFF' OR c.`status` = 'OFFLINE' )) AS cameraOffCount FROM GMV_DEVICE d INNER JOIN GMV_OAUTH o ON d.DEVICE_ID = o.DEVICE_ID LEFT JOIN GMV_DEVICE_CHANNEL c ON d.DEVICE_ID = c.DEVICE_ID where o.DEL = 0 and d.REGISTER_TIME IS NOT NULL
and o.ALIAS LIKE CONCAT('%',#{alias,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%')
GROUP BY d.DEVICE_ID, o.CREATE_TIME ORDER BY o.CREATE_TIME DESC, d.DEVICE_ID

SELECT d.DEVICE_ID, c.CHANNEL_ID, c.NAME, c.MANUFACTURER, c.MODEL, IF(d.`status` = 1 AND DATE_ADD(d.register_time, INTERVAL d.register_expires SECOND) > NOW() AND (c.`status` = 'ON' OR c.`status` = 'OK' OR c.`status` = 'ONLINE' OR c.`status` = ''), "ON", "OFF") `STATUS`, c.CIVIL_CODE, c.ADDRESS, c.PARENTAL, c.BLOCK, c.PARENT_ID, c.IP_ADDRESS, c.PORT, c.PASSWORD, c.LONGITUDE, c.LATITUDE, c.PTZ_TYPE, c.SUPPLY_LIGHT_TYPE, c.ALIAS_NAME, c.SNAPSHOT, CONCAT(a.DIR_PATH, "/", a.FILE_NAME, ".", a.FILE_FORMAT) picUrl FROM GMV_DEVICE d INNER JOIN GMV_DEVICE_CHANNEL c ON d.DEVICE_ID = c.DEVICE_ID LEFT JOIN GMV_FILE_INFO a ON a.ID = if(c.over_pic_id = 0 or c.over_pic_id is null, (SELECT MAX(ID) FROM GMV_FILE_INFO WHERE FILE_TYPE = 0 AND IS_DEL = 0 and DEVICE_ID = c.DEVICE_ID AND CHANNEL_ID = c.CHANNEL_ID), c.over_pic_id)
where d.DEVICE_ID = #{deviceId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} order by c.CHANNEL_ID

SELECT b.ID fileId, a.DEVICE_ID deviceId, a.CHANNEL_ID channelId, a.BIZ_ID bizId, a.CT createTime, a.ST startTime, a.ET endTime, b.FILE_NAME fileName, CONCAT( IF( b.DIR_PATH IS NULL OR b.DIR_PATH = '.', '', IF( LEFT(b.DIR_PATH, 2) = './', SUBSTRING(b.DIR_PATH, 2), b.DIR_PATH ) ), '/', b.FILE_NAME, '.', b.FILE_FORMAT ) AS videoUrl, a.STATE state, b.FILE_SIZE size, a.STREAM_APP_NAME nodeName, b.BIZ_TIME bizTime FROM GMV_RECORD a LEFT JOIN GMV_FILE_INFO b ON a.BIZ_ID = b.BIZ_ID AND b.IS_DEL = 0 AND b.FILE_TYPE = 1 WHERE a.DEVICE_ID = #{deviceId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND a.CHANNEL_ID = #{channelId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ORDER BY a.CT DESC
SELECT CONCAT( b.ABS_PATH, "/", b.FILE_NAME, ".", b.FILE_FORMAT ) videoUrl FROM GMV_FILE_INFO b WHERE b.IS_DEL = 0 AND b.FILE_TYPE = 1 AND b.ID = #{fileId}
